inference.method: Firing = min of antecedent memberships; each output term is cut at the strongest firing of the rules concluding it (max aggregation); the output is the union of the cut terms, defuzzified by centroid. Contribution = share of the aggregated area where the rule's term is the maximum (split equally between rules tied for the same cut); masked rules fired but a stronger rule set the same term's cut. Leave-one-out change = output with the rule minus output without it (0-1 scale).
